scope: Chrome media element, same-origin HTTP state, browser playback and actual select change handling. Polling instrumentation checks both select value setters and option DOM mutations. The OS-native select popup is not automated by this CDP runner.

checks.name: Image mode shows a choice prompt while preserving reference identity
Reference and sample remain the two playable catalog choices
Image-mode polling leaves select values and option DOM untouched
Choosing the initial reference explicitly enters video mode
Explicit selection reveals the video inside the mobile scroll viewport
Paused-video polling leaves select values and option DOM untouched
Reference MP4 plays with advancing time and decoded portrait frames
Switching to the sample changes the native source and label
Image mode hides and pauses video while retaining the remembered sample
Reference remains selectable after changing sample back to images
Choosing the same remembered reference after image mode starts video again
Broadcast-screen mode selector still restores the remembered video
Media error returns to images and the video-choice prompt
The same reference can be reselected after the error fallback
A real missing MP4 returns to images and the choice prompt
Explicit same-reference retry reloads the valid source after a real MP4 failure
The reloaded reference decodes and plays after real-file error recovery
No uncaught browser exceptions in media selection workflows
